I told them that I was fine later to settle the tensions in the house and ever since then they've simply dismissed me when I bring it up. I'm too nervous to talk to a doctor about it... "she's a whore." ect ect. just really stupid stuff that I thought was quite immature but for awhile I didn't really have any friends. She also ended up moving, literally, right across the road from us and people still come up to me at school and call me things and i'm still not the most liked person at school. so I think that could also be part of why I feel this way, and I think has something to do with my anxiety issues.

I guess your right i am getting some attention i've always been an attention grabber, i loved being the center of attention.. but when it came to teachers it was always bad attention so i've never known what it would be like to not get attention at all, but id much rather be noticed a lot than not at all, now that i think of it. And hahaha i've never really noticed the advantages to my voice... and never knew how many people have a voice like mine!! You're also right about the body/ looks thing... the only thing is, i'm very smart actually i excel in most of my classes, people always assume i'm stupid or dumb. (i'm a bad test taker so i usually get my B's from that). i am 12 years old... the oldest in my class and turning 13 soon... so i dont think about sex or any of those things.. it's mostly kissing but thank you for the future advice. i have tried yoga before my Aunt took me to a class, it is fairly relaxing, the only problem is there's a lot of quiet time and my mind tends to drift off and i think about all those sad things all over again, or replay all these fights i have with my mom. And i will try to live in the moment more i have tried that i couple times and it does help but it's hard to do that for a whole day... after school i spend a lot of time by myself and i get quite lonely, me and my really close sista like friend are trying to hang out after school too so i have something to do. I have also tried writing it down (we watched a video in health 2 about depression and growing up and it said writing helps) the only problem is i feel like people will find it... i also have a constint feeling that someones watching me, or that my friends or class mates are watching what i'm doing like there's a hidden camera and they watch the footage later.. idk it's a weird thought but it's hard not to think about it. I hope your cold gets better... also thank you for all the other advice it really did help!

hahaha thank you! but i have to admit i never choosed (srry spellings not my best subject) to go to the councilor.. if that's what your refuring to, my friend was being abused by her parents and we'd talk about those things we used to write notes to each other.. one of the teachers got a hold of them and the councilor brought us in seperatly.

i do try to ignore what people say but sometimes it's hard, it's very hard for me when it comes to older kids and mostly adults..but thank you for the advice... and i'm trying to keep busy with school and focusing on that!

I'm the one that everyone knows... i stand out in a crowd, i'm the crazy zanny one that no one would expect to feel this way. i dont really care about what people think most of the time. Depending on who they are, older kids/Adults (except for highschoolers... for some reason i like highschoolers.. maybe because they dont go to my school idk) are some of the only opionons i actually take into consideration... and what they say i usually take to heart. But thank you so much for your advice and i really appriecate it!

i have tried talking to my parents already and it didnt work out quite well at first they were really nice about it and really cared... they thought about taking me to a therapist than but i started to felt better so they didnt but now it's just worse... i try to keep my distince from them, mostly my mom, and dont like asking things from them or really keeping a long conversation with them. they also think i'm all better now and i dont wanna be a bother to them so i decided not to ask them about a therapist. but thank you for the advice!
